pages.text: The best shielding: a Block of Lead cuts radiation to $(bold)a tenth$().

pages.title: Galena
pages.text: Galena ore: stone and deepslate, Y -32 to 64, about as common as iron.$(br2)Raw Galena smelts or blasts into Lead Ingots.

pages.title: Lead-Lined EVA Module
pages.text: Carry it anywhere. Under a $(bold)full sealed EVA suit$() it halves all incoming radiation, carried sources included.$(br2)$(danger)Heavy:$() Slowness I while carried, suit or not.

pages.title: Lead-Lined EVA Module
pages.text: Six lead ingots, two Tattered Clothing Scraps and a Suit Patch Kit.
